entryRule.description: Reviewer-authored conservative entry tiers use the strongest explicitly F2P variant represented by a generic exact monster selector: combat level 1-9 => target skill 1; 10-24 => 10; 25-39 => 20; 40-59 => 30; 60-79 => 40; 80-99 => 50; 100+ => 60. These are planning recommendations, not game requirements or guaranteed safe/efficient levels. All six skill lanes may use these same simple tiers. Constitution remains passive XP alongside offensive combat. Suitable equipment, supplies, offensive skills and personal access still matter.
entryRule.methodNote: Suggested entry uses conservative combat-level tiers. It is a planning recommendation; gear, supplies and other combat skills still matter.

npcExport.limits: Read only. Membership and many HP fields are unknown; Wiki supplies F2P and variant facts. No cache XP is inferred.

monsters.label: Cow
monsters.notes: Mixed member/F2P variants; retain existing method and admitted source filtering.

monsters.label: Chicken
monsters.notes: Champions Guild option requires guild access; ordinary Lumbridge/Falador/Taverley sources provide F2P alternatives.

locations.location: Farm east of the [[River Lum]] in [[Lumbridge]]

monsters.label: Goblin (Lumbridge)
monsters.notes: Exact Lumbridge selector is level2; source present in12850 section1, unlike generic Goblin.

monsters.label: Spider
monsters.notes: Common F2P level1 and Stronghold level15 variants; conservative generic entry10. Underground Pass and Ape Atoll variants are members.

monsters.label: Giant spider
monsters.notes: Includes level2/4 common sources and level29/33 stronger sources. Generic conservative entry20 also covers Lumbridge12850 section1, though that local variant is easier.

monsters.label: Al Kharid warrior
monsters.notes: Palace guards can assist one another when attacked; equipment and food remain necessary. Thieving25 is for pickpocketing, not combat. Exact NPC18/cache combat18.

monsters.label: Scorpion
monsters.notes: Generic selector includes level14 ordinary and level26 Stronghold variants; stronger F2P variant sets conservative entry20. Al Kharid mine is chunk13107, not13105.

locations.location: [[Stronghold of Security#Pit of Pestilence (3rd level)|Stronghold of Security]] (3rd level)

monsters.label: Zombie
monsters.notes: Generic level12/22/29 variants; combat rate and XP per kill left unknown.

monsters.label: Skeleton
monsters.notes: Generic level15/16/32/46/51/58 variants. Strongest F2P level58 yields conservative entry30. Crandor requires Dragon Slayer route; ordinary F2P sewers provide alternatives.

locations.location: [[Stronghold of Security#Sepulchre of Death (4th level)|Stronghold of Security]] (4th level)

monsters.label: Hill giant
monsters.notes: Update existing six combat method entry levels1 to20 under this authored policy, preserving their existing per-kill XP. Current Wiki37203057 and exact cache IDs agree on combat26; older combat44 assumption is stale. Edgeville resource-dungeon alternative requires Dungeoneering20; ordinary Edgeville Dungeon does not.

locations.location: [[Edgeville Dungeon hill giant resource dungeon|Edgeville Dungeon resource dungeon]]

monsters.label: Moss giant
monsters.notes: Ordinary F2P Varrock Sewers source is ungated by Dungeoneering. Crandor route requires Dragon Slayer. Pirates Cove variant and Varrock Sewers resource dungeon (Dungeoneering65) are members.

monsters.label: Ice warrior
monsters.notes: Asgarnian Ice Dungeon is F2P; Ice Queens lair variant is members. Nearby aggressive monsters and appropriate gear affect practical safety.

monsters.label: Ice giant
monsters.notes: Asgarnian Ice Dungeon F2P source. Chaos Tunnels, White Wolf Mountain and Ice Queens lair locations are members.

monsters.label: Lesser demon
monsters.notes: Ordinary Crandor and Karamja Dungeon F2P source; Crandor route requires Dragon Slayer. Karamja Volcano resource dungeon alternative requires Dungeoneering25. Wilderness alternatives have separate access/risk.

monsters.label: Greater demon
monsters.notes: F2P sources are Wilderness/Forinthry/Demonic Ruins; membership alone does not establish an admitted safe route. Slayer level1 metadata is not an active assignment gate for ordinary combat XP.

monsters.label: Deadly red spider
monsters.notes: F2P Varrock Sewers and Crandor/Karamja Dungeon sources; Edgeville Dungeon Wilderness spider location is listed members, unlike those alternatives. Combat95 does not mean target skill95.

monsters.label: Hellhound
monsters.notes: Two F2P variants combat92 and105; generic selector conservatively uses105 and entry60. F2P sources are Wilderness; Taverley Dungeon/resource dungeon are members. Level105 max melee1080 is materially more dangerous than level92 max264.

locations.location: Northwest of the [[Flesh-hatcher Mhekarnahz resource dungeon]] (level 34 [[Wilderness]])
